8274.title: Retryable Codex errors leave silent turns without a terminal boundary
8274.rootCauseOneLine: Retryable errors are forwarded without a reconnect-silence deadline, leaving the open turn without a terminal boundary when the child stops producing events.

prReviews.topFinding: An open linked PR exists; no PR branch or code was executed and no duplicate fix was attempted.

8274.proposedFix: Bound reconnect inactivity for active turns, clear the deadline on progress or cleanup, terminate stalled work with existing failure deltas, and retire the stuck child.
8274.caveats: A synthetic child reproduces bridge liveness; real pool 502 behavior, historical durations, scheduler slot retention, and the existing PR implementation are not independently verified.
